agent_source_policy: openai, offline_fallback, mock, or failed; source is persisted per trial

benchmark_cases.name: preprocessing_disagreement
benchmark_cases.question: Predict target from the supplied features.

evaluation_settings.repetition_design: same split and training-only profile; stochastic LLM response is the intended varying factor

gate_mode_definitions.always_reconcile: invoke the existing reconciliation path for every valid soft disagreement
gate_mode_definitions.llm_only: retain the initial agent plan after initial validation; never reconcile soft disagreement
gate_mode_definitions.selective: invoke reconciliation only when the versioned soft-challenge policy authorizes a challenge

limitations: Empirical reference compares only supported families under this CV procedure.
Offline/mock rows are not evidence about live LLM behavior.
